arguments: Missing validation of IPC vector counts before indexing in_vec/out_vec
message.text: Missing validation of IPC vector counts before indexing in_vec/out_vec

properties.metisTriageReason: Verdict: The reported out-of-bounds IPC vector indexing is contradicted by the resolved call path. Evidence: The only codebase call dispatches through tfm_crypto_api_dispatcher to tfm_crypto_asymmetric_sign_interface, and the service allocates PSA_MAX_IOVEC-sized, zero-initialized in_vec/out_vec arrays before populating them and dispatching, so insufficient IPC counts do not make in_vec[1], in_vec[2], or out_vec[0] outside the arrays. Gap: none.
properties.mitigation: Validate the expected number of input and output vectors for each function_id before indexing, or ensure this function receives and checks in_len/out_len from the dispatcher. Reject calls with insufficient vectors before reading in_vec[n], out_vec[n], iov, or encoded_key.
properties.reasoning: The interface directly indexes in_vec[0], in_vec[1], and out_vec[0] without any local validation that the caller supplied enough input and output vectors. Later cases in the same function also access in_vec[2]. If this function can be reached with malformed or cross-version IPC metadata, these unchecked array accesses can read outside the vector arrays or dereference attacker-controlled/uninitialized vector entries across the non-secure to secure partition boundary. The file does not show any validation of vector counts before these accesses, so the safety of this code depends entirely on external dispatch guarantees.
